nom: Cetaphil Vitamin C Serum with Niacinamide and Sunflower Seed Oil

avis.texte: The serum absorbs very fast and does not leave any residue behind. I did not feel any reaction or discomfort with the serum (my skin can be sensitive to niaminicide in high concentrations), if anything I might follow up with a second product if my skin was particularly dry, sunburnt, or in need of attention. The dropper holds a lot but with how fast it absorbs and how thick the consistency is (positive! It never drips or runs too fast!) I feel like I've already made a dent in the bottle. I really like the packaging—it fits in with the other droppers in my little skincare apothecary! I read that collagen needs vitamin c to function so I like the science of this too.

Adding this into my skin care routine is a game changer! This gives my skin such a beautiful glow which makes my skin look so healthy and glowy that I feel confident even without wearing makeup. I love that it's effective enough to deliver noticeable results but doesn't have that overpowering smell. I've tried other concentrating formulas that had a smell I could not stand. This one strikes the perfect balance!
